title: REQ · Exporter JSON format, frozen-only inclusion and empty round are covered by mocked-source tests
summary: Exporter behavior is proven with a fake ExportSource
description: Context: Exporter.Export filters ListByRound results by FrozenIDs in snapshot order, returns a non-nil empty slice for an empty round and wraps source errors. Desired behavior: fake-source unit tests assert the JSON format, frozen-only inclusion, empty round and error propagation. Expected result: tests pass. Why: protects the handoff contract.
acceptance_criteria: Given contributions A,B,C and frozen ids C,A, When Export runs, Then only C then A are returned with Author, Content and CreatedAt mapped
Given no frozen ids, When Export runs and is JSON-encoded, Then it contains "contributions":[]
Given a failing source, When Export runs, Then errors.Is matches the source error
Given an Export value, When marshaled, Then the JSON keys match the documented format

preserve: Export JSON field names and ExportVersion

technical_constraints: Use the fakeSource and errSource doubles
